class_name_policy: Original pinned TPT human prompt names, preserving 1000 entries including source duplicate names; not WNIDs and not comma-separated ImageNet synonyms. Only current project prompt template is to be used, not imported TPT multi-template lists.
v2_label_policy: Parse directory name as its true integer ImageNet index. If using generic ImageFolder, its lexicographic local labels need explicit mapping; do not confuse numeric labels and lexicographic order.
